name: Mileden for Peace & Atonement
source:
Mileden, an organization of magic soldiers who use sorcery to purge evil and protect the island's peace.

Sakura Yuki joined Mileden in pursuit of the missing legendary magic soldier who saved him in the past: Syndia Satisfar.

What awaited him was a decaying organization, the wounds and pasts carried by the magic soldiers, and the truth behind the vanished Syndia.

Amidst this, a group of youths struggle and clash while forming bonds together...


Today, they fight yet again.
For the island's peace, and for atonement...

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/9333]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
米莱登（Mileden），一个由魔法士兵组成的组织，他们利用魔法来清除邪恶并保护岛上的和平。

樱由希与米勒登一起追寻过去救过他的失踪传奇魔法战士：辛迪亚·萨蒂斯法尔。

等待他的，是腐朽的组织、魔兵们所背负的伤痛和过去，以及消失的辛迪亚背后的真相。

在此之中，一群年轻人在斗争、冲突中结下不解之缘……


今天，他们再次战斗。
为了岛屿的和平，为了赎罪……

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/9333]Novelgame[/url]]
